title: What Is Yield Analysis? A Guide to the Semiconductor Job of Tracing Defect Causes with Defect Maps and Process Data
excerpt: Yield analysis is the job of tracing why the good-chip rate dropped in a semiconductor fab, using defect maps, measurements, process history, and equipment data. This beginner's guide explains how it relates to defect inspection, SPC, failure analysis, and process data analysis, plus the terms you'll see in job postings.
